behavior: The API serves invoice and receipt PDFs built on the server
acceptance: R-47: public GET /v1/invoices/{id}/invoice.pdf returns 200 application/pdf with number, issuer and client blocks from the invoice's copies (no issuer block without billing details), amount, token, network, due date and pay link, from database data only; an unknown id gives 404

R-47: GET /v1/invoices/{id}/receipt.pdf answers 409 until the invoice is paid, then 200 with the paid time and tx hashes; tests read the PDF text; codeberg.org/go-pdf/fpdf v0.12.0 is the only new dependency; openapi.yaml and docs/backend/api.md describe both routes
notes: 2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: Independent review passed. Deps: only codeberg.org/go-pdf/fpdf v0.12.0 (go.sum +2 lines, go mod verify ok). document renders from invoice.Get data only; fonts go:embed, byte-identical to upstream notofonts unhinted NotoSans 2.015 (sha256 checked), OFL.txt present. Public routes reuse invoice.Get: 404 for unknown and malformed ids; no client email in the PDF. Receipt 409 unless payment_status=paid; paid time = max block_time of deposit ledger txs with a recipient_payable entry, which is the completing deposit since split() books nothing to the creator once final or late and deposits book in block order. Amounts via big.Rat FloatString, exact; token/chain lookup does not filter enabled, so disabled tokens still render. Stress-rendered both PDFs with control chars, invalid UTF-8, U+FFFE/FFFF, CJK, RTL, 5000-char words, 3000 newlines, emoji: no panic, no error (bmp() guards the >U+FFFF index panic). ETag sha256 of deterministic bytes via http.ServeContent gives 304; Cache-Control private, no-cache. PUBLIC_WEB_URL reduced to scheme://host after http(s) validation; id is hex-validated, so no link injection. Boundaries: document -> invoice, ledger; invoice -> ledger; no cycle. Tests inflate streams and decode UTF-16 Tj text, cover both acceptance lines. pnpm --filter @forwend/backend test passes. Minor, not blocking: paid time is the completing deposit's block time, not when the second-RPC funded check flipped status.

proof.1: backend: TestInvoicePDF: public GET invoice.pdf gives 200 application/pdf; the PDF text (read with a stdlib zlib + Tj parser) has INV-0002, the issuer block from the invoice's copy, Bill to with client name and address and no client email, 5.00 USDC, base-sepolia (chain 84532), due date 2026-11-01, checkout expiry, created time, note and the pay link https://forwend.test/pay/<id> (also a clickable /URI); two renders give the same bytes and the ETag answers 304; an invoice made without billing details or client has no FROM or BILL TO block. TestInvoicePDFFitsLongTexts: longest texts wrap and are cut with an ellipsis, emoji print as ?. TestInvoicePDFNotFound: unknown and malformed ids give 404 invoice_not_found on both routes. Data comes only from invoice.Get (database)
proof.2: backend: TestReceiptPDF: receipt.pdf answers 409 invoice_not_paid while open and while partially paid, then 200 once ledger.Process marks the invoice paid, with the paid time (block time of the deposit that completed the amount), both deposit tx hashes, Settlement Pending, and after settlement Settled with the settlementTxHash and a new ETag; go.mod adds only codeberg.org/go-pdf/fpdf v0.12.0 (go mod tidy pulled nothing else); docs-check: apps/backend/api/openapi.yaml and docs/backend/api.md describe both routes
